purpose: Turn the conservative Molino interval-overlap candidate set into spectroscopically calibrated membership probabilities with held-out and bootstrap uncertainty.
disclosure: The viable 112-object crossmatch, the candidate-domain counts of 43 labels with 25 members and 18 nonmembers, and the photo-z versus spectroscopic-z diagnostic were known before this freeze. No classifier, held-out probability, Brier score, log loss, AUC, calibration error, or candidate probability had been evaluated.

training_domain.rule: Use only extended spectroscopic matches outside 1 arcsec whose Molino 95-percent first-peak interval contains the cluster redshift, matching the frozen conservative candidate domain.
features: absolute BPZ first-peak offset from cluster redshift
training_domain.missing_values: Values >=90 or non-finite are set missing and median-imputed within each training fold with missingness indicators.
training_domain.spatial_groups: 12 fixed polar-angle sectors about the BCG
training_domain.cross_validation: five-fold shuffled StratifiedGroupKFold with spatial sector as group and random seed 2129

model.bootstrap_rule: stratified resampling within the member and nonmember classes, preserving observed candidate-domain prevalence

candidate_scope.rule: Predict only for the frozen candidate ledger inside 30 arcsec. Override probabilities to 0 or 1 for unique MUSE-matched nonmembers or members; retain classifier probabilities for unmatched photometric candidates.
